action: Shows the high-detail figure: Toji with sword, curse-baby head with closed eyes and pursed lips, wrapped sword grip.
Refines the gripping hand: crisp nail plates with a cut cuticle line, knuckle bulges, and fine creases dabbed in at each finger joint.
tool: Small crease brush (brush shelf shows MaskPe, MaskLa, Smooth, SelectR, SelectL, ClipCurve, SliceCurve, KnifeCurve, TrimRect, KnifeLasso, SK_Hair)
why: Hands read through hard nail edges and joint creases.
reader_equivalent: Crease / Draw Sharp small radius; Pinch for nail edge.

action: Turns the full figure front, 3/4 and back: defined pecs/abs/back muscles under a tight T-shirt, the coiled curse body made of repeated inflated segments around the torso.
why: Check body anatomy and segmented creature silhouette from all sides.

action: Sculpts the clenched fist: thumb wrapping over fingers, carves the deep fold lines between fingers and on the thumb with a dynamic-size crease brush, then checks the fist and forearm veins from side.
why: Clenched fist needs deep sharp separations between finger masses.
reader_equivalent: Crease brush with small radius (Radius Unit: Scene for constant size), Smooth after.

action: Works the eye: thick upper lid line with a flicked outer tip, thinner lower lid line, iris with ring and pupil, and a pair of soft bag/crease grooves under the eye; strong angled brow above.
tool: Crease/line brush (lines appear dark, possibly polypaint or deep cavity)
why: Anime eye is defined by graphic lid lines on a shallow form.
reader_equivalent: Crease / Draw Sharp for lid lines; Layer or Clay for lid fold; Smooth.

action: Shows the head: fringe made of many separate long tapered locks with sharp pointed tips hanging over the eyes, smile carved as a sharp line with scar at the mouth corner.
why: Hair fringe read as distinct pointed strands; mouth as a crisp single cut line.
reader_equivalent: Separate lock objects or Snake Hook + Pinch; Crease for mouth line.
